notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
We've fixed a horrid bug that teleported players from the first area to about a third of the way through the game... shout outs to various Let's Plays for making us aware of that!

Seeing as Tango Fiesta is out, I've updated the related text in the game to reflect that too.

Enjoy, and happy gaming!
